name: lz-room-frame
description: Multi-person framing for meeting rooms: any camera in, AI framing presets, tile layouts, out as window, NDI, virtual camera or stream; control API for Crestron and Q-SYS
author: Lars Zumpe

scripts.dev: node scripts/prepare-assets.mjs && concurrently -k -n web,app "vite" "wait-on tcp:4196 && cross-env LZRF_DEV=1 electron ."
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && node scripts/build-helpers.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --mac --publish never
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && node scripts/build-helpers.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --win --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && node scripts/build-helpers.mjs && electron-builder --config electron-builder.cjs --linux --publish never
